UnitStatement: core/handoff/review_geometry/package.py is a glTF review-geometry export package builder for DEL-17-08 emitting a narrow glTF JSON review artifact for invented centerline segments.
The review-geometry exporter records stable identity, sidecar mappings, loss reporting, diagnostics, provenance, privacy, and professional-boundary notices.
The review-geometry exporter does not emit binary GLB, surface/tube geometry, solver-fidelity geometry, target compatibility evidence, formal validation evidence, or professional reliance records.
Review geometry export uses REVIEW_GEOMETRY_EXPORT_VERSION 0.1.0 and GLTF_VERSION 2.0.
REQUIRED_SOURCE_BASIS_REFS for review geometry are Deliverable DEL-17-01, Deliverable DEL-17-02, and Document GLTF-2.0.
Loss categories for review geometry are: exported, omitted, approximated, delegated, unsupported, and tbd.

The review-geometry PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY requires human review, supports visual review and identity correlation, and makes no release, target-compatibility, solver-fidelity, analysis-fidelity, solver-validation, compliance, certification, sealing, or approval claim.

Default boundary note: glTF review geometry is visual review support only and is not solver-fidelity geometry, analysis-fidelity geometry, target compatibility evidence, code compliance evidence, or professional reliance evidence.
v1 review geometry emits JSON .gltf line-mode centerline geometry with embedded buffer data; GLB and surface/tube geometry remain future work.
The sidecar ID map remains authoritative for audit correlation even when glTF extras carry direct identity metadata.
build_review_geometry_export_package builds a deterministic glTF review-geometry export package from export_id, source model refs/hash, geometry payload, stable_id_map, and loss_report.
render_review_geometry_gltf renders deterministic JSON glTF line-mode centerline review geometry from a geometry payload and export profile.
Each centerline element is encoded as a glTF LINES primitive (mode 1) with a POSITION VEC3 accessor over two endpoint nodes packed as 6 little-endian floats into an embedded base64 buffer.
glTF mesh primitives and nodes carry openpipestress extras with identity metadata linking a canonical CenterlineElement ref to the glTF target ref.
diagnostics_for_review_geometry_export_package returns deterministic diagnostics for glTF review-geometry packages.
Diagnostic RG-LENGTH-UNIT-NOT-METERS (blocking) fires when source length units are not resolved to meters.
Diagnostic RG-COORDINATE-BASIS-UNSUPPORTED (blocking) fires when payload does not declare coordinate basis gltf_y_up_right_handed_meters.
Diagnostic RG-GEOMETRY-MISSING (blocking) fires when review geometry lacks at least one node and one centerline element.
Diagnostic RG-DUPLICATE-CANONICAL-ID (blocking) fires when review geometry contains duplicate canonical IDs.
Diagnostic RG-UNRESOLVED-NODE-REF (blocking) fires when a centerline element references a missing endpoint node.
Diagnostic RG-ZERO-LENGTH-SEGMENT (blocking) fires when a centerline element has identical endpoint coordinates.
Diagnostic RG-GLTF-ASSET-VERSION-MISSING (blocking) fires when generated glTF does not declare asset.version 2.0.
Diagnostic RG-STABLE-ID-MAP-MISSING (blocking) fires when the package has no sidecar stable ID map entries.
Diagnostic RG-LOSS-CATEGORY-UNSUPPORTED (blocking) fires when a loss report entry uses a category outside the DEL-17-02 taxonomy.
Diagnostic RG-ARTIFACT-FORMAT-UNSUPPORTED (blocking) fires when the profile artifact_format is not gltf_json_embedded_buffer.
Diagnostic RG-SOURCE-BASIS-REFS-MISSING (blocking) fires when the profile omits required source-basis references (DEL-17-01, DEL-17-02, GLTF-2.0).
Diagnostic RG-PROFILE-AUTHORITY-TERM (blocking) fires when export profile free metadata contains prohibited authority wording.
Diagnostic RG-PRIVACY-BOUNDARY-VIOLATION (blocking) fires when private/protected/commercial payload-embedded or telemetry_allowed privacy fields are true.
write_review_geometry_export_package writes model.gltf plus manifest, id_map, loss_report, validation_report, and diagnostics JSON sidecars using deterministic encodings.
_checksum computes a sha256 JCS-compatible JSON payload hash with payload_ref and payload_scope metadata.
core/handoff/stress_neutral package is the stress-neutral CSV/JSON export package foundation, exporting build, render, write, diagnostics, and canonical helpers.
core/handoff/stress_neutral/package.py is the stress-neutral CSV/JSON export package builder for DEL-17-06, a project-owned review and regression artifact.
The stress-neutral package preserves result identity, units, source refs, stable IDs, loss reporting, diagnostics, provenance, privacy, and professional-boundary notices.
The stress-neutral package does not become a vendor format, solver input deck, validation record, code-compliance record, or professional reliance record.
Stress-neutral REQUIRED_SOURCE_BASIS_REFS are Deliverables DEL-08-04, DEL-14-02, DEL-14-05, and DEL-17-02.
Stress-neutral CSV columns are: result_id, canonical_ref, row_kind, result_family, load_case_ref, station_ref, component_ref, value, unit, dimension, correlation_status.

The stress-neutral PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY requires human review, supports review/regression-comparison-input/downstream tooling, and makes no release, external-compatibility, solver-validation, compliance, certification, sealing, or approval claim.

Stress-neutral default boundary notes state it is a project-owned review/regression artifact, not a vendor format/solver input deck/target compatibility claim, with diagnostic-only comparison semantics excluding pass/fail tolerances.
build_stress_neutral_export_package builds a deterministic stress-neutral CSV/JSON export package from source result/run/model refs, hashes, result rows, stable_id_map, and loss_report.
render_stress_neutral_csv renders deterministic stress-neutral CSV text from normalized rows sorted by result_id.
diagnostics_for_stress_neutral_export_package returns deterministic diagnostics for stress-neutral package boundaries.
Diagnostic SN-RESULT-ROWS-MISSING (blocking) fires when the package has no result rows.
Diagnostic SN-STABLE-ID-MAP-MISSING (blocking) fires when the package has no stable ID map entries.
Diagnostic SN-LOSS-REPORT-MISSING (blocking) fires when the package has no loss report entries.
Diagnostic SN-UNIT-DIMENSION-MISSING (blocking) fires when a result row is missing unit or dimension metadata.
Diagnostic SN-LOSS-CATEGORY-UNSUPPORTED (blocking) fires when a loss report entry uses a category outside the DEL-17-02 taxonomy.
Diagnostic SN-COMPARISON-SEMANTICS-UNSAFE (blocking) fires when the profile comparison_semantics is not diagnostic_export_only_no_pass_fail.
Diagnostic SN-SOURCE-BASIS-REFS-MISSING (blocking) fires when the profile omits required result/export/run/comparison source-basis references.
Diagnostic SN-PROFILE-AUTHORITY-TERM (blocking) fires when export profile free metadata contains authority wording.
Diagnostic SN-PRIVACY-BOUNDARY-VIOLATION (blocking) fires when private/protected/commercial payload-embedded or telemetry_allowed privacy fields are true.
canonical_csv normalizes CSV text (CRLF/CR to LF, rstripped lines, trailing blank lines removed) for deterministic hashing and writing.
write_stress_neutral_export_package writes stress_neutral_results.csv (ascii) plus manifest, result_rows, stable_id_map, loss_report, validation_report, and diagnostics JSON sidecars.

_unit_system_disclosure records unit system ref, storage convention entered_units_preserved, model/result/target units, conversion policy/performed/scope, and decision_basis_refs (DEC-018, DEL-02-02).
Stress-neutral storage convention preserves entered units; default conversion policy is result_row_units_preserved_no_export_time_conversion with conversion_performed false.
core/handoff/target_mapping package exports target mapping and unsupported-behavior contract helpers including build_target_mapping_contract and diagnostics_for_target_mapping_contract.
core/handoff/target_mapping/contract.py is the provider-neutral target mapping contract for DEL-15-02 recording mapping metadata and unsupported/approximate behavior.
The target mapping contract does not select a commercial target, invoke an external solver, or make professional acceptance claims.
Supported target system kinds are: local_fea, external_prover, commercial_tool_reference, generic_downstream_modeling, and TBD.
Supported mapping kinds are: entity, field, unit, result, load_case, boundary_condition, and metadata.
Supported behavior statuses are: unsupported, approximate, requires_human_review, not_implemented, and TBD.
Unit value kinds requiring unit metadata are: quantity, unit, and dimensioned_quantity.
build_target_mapping_contract builds a deterministic DEL-15-02 target mapping contract envelope (PKG-15, SOW-074, OBJ-017) with mapping records and unsupported/approximate behavior flags.
diagnostics_for_target_mapping_contract returns deterministic diagnostics for missing mapping context.
Diagnostic TM-TARGET-KIND-UNSUPPORTED (blocking) fires when target system kind is not part of the provider-neutral taxonomy.
Diagnostic TM-SOURCE-CONTEXT-MISSING (blocking) fires when target mapping lacks the required source_context object.

Source context must carry model_hash, units_manifest_ref, entity_id_refs, library_refs, rule_pack_refs, unresolved_assumption_refs, warning_refs, and privacy_context, else TM-SOURCE-CONTEXT-FIELD-MISSING fires.
Diagnostic TM-MAPPING-KIND-UNSUPPORTED (warning) fires when a mapping kind is outside the provider-neutral taxonomy.
Diagnostic TM-UNIT-METADATA-MISSING (blocking) fires when unit-bearing mapped values lack explicit unit and dimension metadata.
Diagnostic TM-MAPPING-DISCLOSURE-MISSING (warning) fires when unsupported/approximate mappings lack assumption_refs or warning_refs.
Diagnostic TM-PROHIBITED-AUTHORITY-TERM (blocking) fires when a behavior label contains prohibited authority or lifecycle wording.
Diagnostic TM-BEHAVIOR-STATUS-UNSUPPORTED (blocking) fires when an unsupported behavior status is not part of the contract taxonomy.
Diagnostic TM-HUMAN-REVIEW-REQUIRED (blocking) fires when unsupported/approximate target behavior does not require human review.
Diagnostic TM-AFFECTED-REFS-MISSING (warning) fires when unsupported behavior does not identify affected source or target records.
provenance_checker.py validates already-parsed material, section, and component library payloads at the import boundary.

The provenance checker checks required provenance fields, redistribution/review disposition for public imports, private-only data handling, suspected protected-content quarantine, and unit/value-level provenance metadata for imported numeric values.
The provenance checker projects import findings into a PKG-02-style diagnostic envelope.

The provenance checker does not parse external file formats and does not make legal conclusions about licenses or redistribution rights; unresolved rights remain review findings for the human project authority.
The open_pipe_stress_library_import_document crate (version 0.1.0, edition 2021) is the runtime Rust port of the DEL-03-07 provenance-checker contract for library-import payload validation.

The library-import document crate makes no professional, certification, sealing, authentication, or code-compliance claims and performs no external file-format parsing or legal license determinations.
The library-import document crate depends on serde (with derive) and serde_json version 1.
open_pipe_stress_library_import_document is a runtime validation seam for material, section, and component library import payloads.

The library-import document crate is the runtime Rust port of the DEL-03-07 import provenance contract; provenance_checker.py is the design authority and the crate reproduces its semantics for the Tauri/Rust desktop runtime.

At the already-parsed payload boundary the crate checks required provenance fields, redistribution/review disposition for public imports, private-only data handling, suspected protected-content quarantine, unit/value-level provenance, and PKG-02-style diagnostic envelope projection.

The crate does not parse external file formats or make legal license/redistribution determinations; no status it emits is a professional, certification, sealing, authentication, or code-compliance claim — every status is a software finding only.
Public API: validate_library_import(payload, library_kind, intended_visibility) returns an ImportValidationResult.
The seam entry point validate_library_import_tokens(payload, material|section|component, public|private) returns Err for unsupported tokens and never guesses.
ImportValidationResult carries outcome, library_kind, intended_visibility, accepted, and findings, with diagnostics() projecting findings into the PKG-02 envelope.
An import outcome is one of QUARANTINE, REJECTED, REVIEW_REQUIRED, PRIVATE_LOCAL_ONLY, or ACCEPTED_PUBLIC, in that severity precedence order.
tests/provenance_parity.rs mirrors tests/test_library_import_provenance.py one-for-one over the same invented fixtures, guarding against silent divergence between the Rust and Python implementations.
The library-import provenance validation seam (lib.rs) is the runtime port of DEL-03-07 validating already-parsed material/section/component import payloads at the import boundary.

Like the Python contract, the Rust crate does not parse external file formats or make legal license/redistribution determinations, and emits only software findings, not professional/certification/sealing/authentication/code-compliance claims.

REQUIRED_PROVENANCE_FIELDS are the seven fields source_name, source_location, source_license, contributor, contributor_certification, redistribution_status, and review_status, mirroring the Python contract.
Redistribution status constants: PUBLIC_OK_REDIS_STATUS is public_permissive, PRIVATE_REDIS_STATUS is private_only, and PROTECTED_REDIS_STATUS is protected_suspected.
LibraryKind enum (Material, Section, Component) mirrors the Python RECORD_KEYS dispatch table.
LibraryKind::from_token parses material/section/component tokens and returns None for unsupported kinds rather than guessing.
Each LibraryKind maps to a (library_metadata_key, records_array_key) pair, e.g. material_library/material_records.
IntendedVisibility enum (Public, Private) mirrors the Python intended_visibility argument and parses public/private tokens.
ImportFinding carries code, severity (blocking|quarantine|review_required), path, message, and remediation, mirroring the Python ImportFinding dataclass.
ImportFinding::to_diagnostic projects a finding into the PKG-02 import-boundary diagnostic envelope shape.
ImportValidationResult carries outcome, library_kind, intended_visibility, accepted, and findings, mirroring the Python ImportValidationResult.

validate_library_import validates provenance and redistribution controls; public imports must carry accepted public-permissive provenance, while private imports may remain local but cannot bypass protected-content quarantine or missing-provenance findings.

provenance_parity.rs cross-language parity tests mirror test_library_import_provenance.py one-for-one over the same invented fixtures so the Rust port and Python contract agree on outcome and finding codes.
Test: a public component import with accepted public-permissive provenance is accepted with outcome ACCEPTED_PUBLIC and no findings.
Test: a public material import with TBD redistribution rights is REJECTED with findings IMPORT_REDIS_RIGHTS_MISSING and IMPORT_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Test: a private material import with TBD rights can remain local with outcome PRIVATE_LOCAL_ONLY and no IMPORT_REDIS_RIGHTS_MISSING.
Test: missing record provenance blocks import (outcome REJECTED) with IMPORT_PROVENANCE_MISSING and no silent defaults.
Test: protected_suspected redistribution metadata quarantines the import (outcome QUARANTINE) with IMPORT_PROTECTED_CONTENT_SUSPECTED.
Test: removing unit metadata from an imported value yields outcome REJECTED with IMPORT_UNIT_METADATA_MISSING.

Test: import findings map to the PKG-02 diagnostic envelope with class import_boundary, the diagnostic source, an affected_object path, non-empty remediation, and provenance source_name library_import_payload.
provenance_checker.py validates already-parsed material, section, and component library payloads and does not parse external file formats or make legal license determinations.
REQUIRED_PROVENANCE_FIELDS (Python) are source_name, source_location, source_license, contributor, contributor_certification, redistribution_status, and review_status.
Redistribution status values: PUBLIC_OK_REDIS_STATUS public_permissive, PRIVATE_REDIS_STATUSES {private_only}, UNKNOWN_REDIS_STATUSES {unknown, TBD, None}, PROTECTED_REDIS_STATUS protected_suspected.
RECORD_KEYS maps each library kind to its (library_metadata, records) key pair: material, section, and component.
ImportFinding dataclass carries code, severity, path, message, remediation, diagnostic_class (default import_boundary), source, affected_object, and provenance.
ImportFinding.to_diagnostic maps an import finding into the PKG-02 diagnostic envelope shape.
ImportValidationResult carries outcome and findings; accepted is true only for ACCEPTED_PUBLIC or PRIVATE_LOCAL_ONLY outcomes.
validate_library_import raises ValueError for unsupported library_kind or intended_visibility, validating provenance and redistribution controls per public/private intent.
Finding IMPORT_LIBRARY_METADATA_MISSING (blocking) fires when the library metadata object is missing.
Finding IMPORT_RECORD_SET_MISSING (blocking) fires when the library record array is missing.
Finding IMPORT_RECORD_INVALID (blocking) fires when a library record is not an object.
Finding IMPORT_PROVENANCE_MISSING (blocking) fires when the required provenance object is missing.
Finding IMPORT_PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE (blocking) fires when required provenance fields are missing.
Finding IMPORT_PROTECTED_CONTENT_SUSPECTED (quarantine) fires when metadata indicates suspected protected content (protected_suspected redistribution or quarantined review).
Finding IMPORT_REJECTED_SOURCE (blocking) fires when redistribution or review status is rejected.
Finding IMPORT_PRIVATE_DATA_PUBLIC_BLOCKED (blocking) fires when private-only library data is imported as public.
Finding IMPORT_REDIS_RIGHTS_MISSING (blocking) fires when redistribution rights are missing or unresolved for a public import.
Finding IMPORT_REDIS_RIGHTS_UNACCEPTED (blocking) fires when redistribution status is not public_permissive for public import.
Finding IMPORT_REVIEW_REQUIRED (review_required) fires when a public import lacks an accepted review disposition.
Finding IMPORT_UNIT_METADATA_MISSING (blocking) fires when a unit-bearing imported value (with magnitude) is missing unit or dimension metadata.
Finding IMPORT_VALUE_PROVENANCE_MISSING (blocking) fires when an imported value is missing value-level provenance.
_has_unit_metadata accepts a material unit (unit_ref + dimension_id) or a component unit (unit + dimension).
_determine_outcome precedence: quarantine -> QUARANTINE, blocking -> REJECTED, review_required -> REVIEW_REQUIRED, else PRIVATE_LOCAL_ONLY for private or ACCEPTED_PUBLIC.
The open_pipe_stress_load_case_algebra crate (version 0.1.0, edition 2021) provides code-neutral load case algebra for OpenPipeStress and depends on open_pipe_stress_primitive_loads.
The load_case_algebra crate is the bounded implementation slice for DEL-05-02 that combines explicit mechanics operands from primitive load cases or result states.
Load case algebra provides no protected design-code combinations, public default factors, rule-pack expression evaluation, stress recovery, or professional/code-compliance claims.
Load case algebra scope includes user-defined linear combination terms with explicit numeric factors.
Load case algebra scope includes result-state subtraction and min/max range envelopes over compatible mechanics quantities.
Load case algebra performs dimension compatibility checks using the existing primitive-load dimension vocabulary.

Load case algebra result boundary records require explicit unit metadata, provenance reference, result-schema binding, JCS payload reference, and payload-hash reference before quantities are handed to persistence or result envelopes.
Load case algebra preserves analysis status for mechanics-solved, rule-input-incomplete, user-rule-checked, user-rule-failed, and human-review-required states.

Load case algebra emits deterministic findings for missing operands, non-finite factors, unsupported expression shapes, dimension mismatches, duplicate operands, missing result states, and professional-boundary violations.

Load case algebra does not implement a general expression parser, the rule-pack expression evaluator, code-specific load-combination defaults, wind/seismic procedures, stress-recovery formulas, protected standards content, proprietary project data, report rendering, GUI behavior, or headless execution.

Load case algebra inputs are explicit mechanics/result quantities already governed by upstream schemas, units, provenance, and load/status boundaries; unsupported semantics remain deterministic findings or TBD decisions, not silent defaults.

The load case algebra API rejects load-record schema bindings for result quantities; successful result boundary records bind to the canonical model result value or schema-first result-envelope quantity surface.
Load case algebra records payload and hash references only; it does not compute hashes, choose conversion constants, or define code-specific calculation units.

Load case algebra unit tests cover linear combinations, result-state subtraction, range envelopes, dimension compatibility, missing/invalid operands, duplicate operands, result boundary metadata, status propagation, and rejection of human-approval status as an automatic software result.
